shown.message:
Outline rev 12 is pushed (commit af45d4c). It records two changes. I sent no messages.

- **Brief rev. 12:** P7's noise part is now the analytic limit of the bootstrap null. It is exact for nested specifications under homoscedastic noise and not under heteroscedastic noise. C6b says so, and the paper must say it wherever it mentions the bootstrap.
- **Acceptance table moved to the appendix:** `report` did this to fit nine pages. I accept it. Fig 7 and the main-text paragraph still carry the C6 verdict and the absolute held-out R², so the claim stands without the table. §5 now notes the change.

Still pending from `analysis`: `experiment-repo`#6, #7 and #9 (the P6/P7 runs) and the Fig 9 and p-grid tables that `presentation` needs. `story-repo`#2 stays open.
